summary: Produced the import/opening-domain ownership decision as ADR 0012 (docs/adr/0012-importing-plugin-ownership.md), after checking the shipped contracts and runtime: ImportPreview/ImportConflict/OpeningBatch/OpeningCoverage/OpeningEvent all carry x-owner=onboarding (preview records are ephemeral_preview, opening records are owned_fact), the frozen commands are onboarding.opening_batch.draft.save/v1 and onboarding.opening.commit/v1 with no import.* command, current migration leaves are core 0010 / contracts 0003 / cash 0006 / settlement 0005, and the plugin runtime still has exactly 8 manifest fields, fixed PMO_PLUGIN_MODULES, app-run migrations and no URL registration point. The ADR compares option A (new pmo_plugins.onboarding app), B (delivery), C (core), D (contracts or another business owner) and E (defer), with criteria for canonical-owner consistency, migration isolation and sequence collisions, manifest/requires fit, entry gating/routing, import-vs-opening boundaries, relationships to existing cash/open-item/ledger owners, and test/deploy/rollback cost; it decides option A: a new pmo_plugins.onboarding app as the import/opening write owner. It freezes the 8-field manifest (id=onboarding, requires contracts/settlement/cash, capabilities empty), an app-owned migration chain from 0001 with no rewrites of core 0010/contracts 0003/cash 0006/settlement 0005, settings/PMO_PLUGIN_MODULES/delivery-urls root single-write registration, named-service/browser-only onboarding.* exposure with no import.* command and no PAT/MCP/personal-AI approval/payment, preview zero-fact/zero-ledger/zero-source-consumption, per-domain submission through existing owner commands with whole-batch rollback and corrections via existing paths, no new balances/revenue, and insights (PH-257) kept as a separate ownership decision rather than folded into onboarding. PH-256's spec and tasks whitelist were synchronized to the onboarding bootstrap/files (including __init__.py/apps.py/plugin.py, pmo/settings.py, pmo/urls.py) and its decision point now cites ADR 0012; PH-257's decision point/blockers now record the separate insights decision; both stay proposed. No scaffold, product code, migration or contract-schema change was made.
